selection: All 322 frozen discovery-audit events; no winners-only selection or exclusions by old scorability. This 96-symbol sample is NOT a qualified historical NASDAQ under-100M universe.

entry.method: First minute open at or after signal + latency, ceil to minute boundary. No fill assumed within the already-started minute. Exact entry minute required; missing/zero-volume/invalid data stays unknown. BAR_PROXY_NOT_EXECUTABLE.

barriers.session_close: Truncate holding horizon at the exchange close; report SESSION_END separately, with effective horizon. A signal at/after close has NO_SESSION_ENTRY.
barriers.ordering: Check each contiguous positive-volume OHLC bar in chronological order. A boundary-crossing OPEN precedes its high/low. Otherwise simultaneous target and stop is AMBIGUOUS_BOTH, never a win or forced stop. A gap before resolution is UNKNOWN_PATH_GAP; later bars cannot repair it. Resolution before a later gap remains known. Target intrabar exit proxy is threshold; stop gaps use opening price. Outcome times are intervals, not exact ticks.

hypothesis.rule: The last three contiguous completed regular-session minute closes are strictly increasing (c1<c2<c3). No threshold search, fitting, feature combinations or live-rule change.
hypothesis.rationale: Test whether persistence before detection separates continuation from reversal. This bar feature is not order-flow imbalance or buying pressure.

availability: Explicit FINAL_BARS_AVAILABLE_AT_MINUTE_END_SCENARIO; source receipt/revision times absent. Feature reader must respect available_at when supplied and ignore unfinished/future bars.
cost_warning: Fixed stress scenarios only. Spreads, impact and executable quantity are not observed. Bar-proxy results cannot establish net executable expectancy; that field must remain null.

statistics.inference: Exploratory conditional paired session-block differences only. Publish all missingness and daily outcomes. No confirmatory p-value or independence claim.

missingness: Every original event retained. Unknown feature is separate. Compare selected with the same feature-observable baseline. Report target-rate identification bounds (unknowns all failures vs all successes); these are NOT confidence intervals.
stop_rule: Run once, preserve failed result and all unknowns, no tuning on these dates. Independent qualification plus >=500 final evaluable signals still required before any efficacy claim.
next_quote_sample: After labels, choose at most six unresolved rows deterministically by SHA256 of signal ID, stratified only by missingness reason, never returns; save manifest before provider calls. This is measurement repair of development evidence, not independent validation.
